validation.problem_evidence: Product-data aggregation requires Lenovo (nl/nl catalogue + spec pages) and bol.com data; neither exposes a usable public product API. Hand-written scrapers decay silently on layout change and produce quietly-wrong data.
validation.demand_evidence: Concrete in-hand requirement: two named Lenovo URLs (tablet lister + Yoga Tab Gen 2 spec table) must be scraped into typed schemas for an existing aggregation system, with bol.com named as the next source.
validation.not_build_analysis: Without it: N hand-maintained scrapers, days of latency per breakage, live-site hammering during debugging, no version history, and the dominant failure mode is silently incomplete data ingested into the product catalogue.
